steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Palaeozoic Era (541-252 Ma): Cambrian explosion of hard-bodied life, Silurian marine life, Devonian age of fish and early land plants, Carboniferous coal forests, Permian mass extinction

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Cambrian explosion (~541 Ma): rapid diversification of life with hard shells and skeletons, making fossilisation much more common

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Carboniferous (359-299 Ma): warm, humid climate; vast swamp forests of ferns, horsetails and clubmosses formed today's coal deposits

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Permian-Triassic mass extinction (~252 Ma): the 'Great Dying' eliminated ~96% of marine species, caused by massive volcanism (Siberian Traps) and climate change
